standard_prerequisites.name: The universal property of blowing up
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Divisors, the universal property of the blowing up in an ideal
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the factorization of the composition through the given proper morphism once the ideal becomes invertible.

core_obligations: Reduce to a blowing up in an ideal supported on the finite set (proof lines 1149-1160): the domination lemma gives an admissible blowup dominating the given morphism, so one may assume the given morphism is the blowing up in an ideal whose quotient is supported on the finite set of points.

Make the ideal invertible and factor (proof lines 1160-1179): the principalization lemma gives a sequence of blowups in closed points lying above the given set after which the pullback of the ideal is invertible; the universal property of blowing up then produces the morphism from the last member of the chain to the given target, which is the required factorization.
proof_roadmap: Replace the given morphism by an admissible blowing up supported on the finite set.
Principalize the ideal by a sequence of blowups in closed points above the set.
Apply the universal property of blowing up to get the factorization.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a proper morphism which is an isomorphism outside a finite set of closed points with regular local rings of dimension two is dominated by a sequence of blowups in closed points above that set (statement lines 1145-1158). The proof (proof lines 1159-1179) reduces to an admissible blowing up, principalizes its ideal, and applies the universal property of blowing up. H2: a complete three step reduction.
